main.content:
== Semantic Organization ==

BITwiki leverages Semantic MediaWiki to create explicit relationships between pages, enabling dynamic navigation and knowledge discovery. This approach replaces traditional categorization with machine-readable semantic properties.

=== Semantic Properties ===

Semantic properties define relationships between wiki pages:
* [[Has implementation::Page name]] - Links ideas to their implementations
* [[Implements idea::Page name]] - Links implementations to their theoretical foundations
* [[Related to::Page name]] - Creates general knowledge connections
* [[Category::Domain name]] - Assigns pages to knowledge domains

=== Semantic Queries ===

Semantic queries dynamically generate content based on page properties:
* {{#ask: [[Category:Ideas]] | ?Has implementation | format=table }}
* {{#ask: [[Has implementation::+]] | ?Implements idea | format=list }}

=== Knowledge Navigation ===

Semantic properties enable powerful navigation features:
* Dynamic lists of related content
* Faceted browsing by properties
* Automatic categorization based on relationships
* Knowledge graph visualization

=== Semantic Best Practices ===

When adding semantic properties to pages:
# Use consistent property naming conventions
# Define clear relationships between concepts
# Apply properties to all relevant pages
# Regularly review and update semantic structures
# Use semantic forms for consistent data entry

This semantic approach allows BITwiki to function as both a traditional knowledge base and a dynamic knowledge graph, connecting ideas to implementations through explicit relationships.
